beats.note: Proxy Bird A spots a tiny gold shimmer on a map stone at the meadow edge.
Proxy Quadruped A names a careful first look so the glow is treated as a clue, not a prize.
Both stand-ins see the map glow reframe the problem as a kindness to try together.
The first try is playful but incomplete; Proxy Bird A pauses instead of rushing.
Proxy Quadruped A offers the kinder step; Proxy Bird A chooses it.
They use the lesson about noticing first, then trying a kind step.
The map is put away and the meadow is left as they found it.
A gentle hook: what will they notice next?
